statement: WITH channels AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(channel_id AS STRING) AS channel_id FROM prod_tads.youtube_too.yt_sl_channels WHERE channel_id IS NOT NULL), raw_categories AS (SELECT CAST(canonical_id AS STRING) AS channel_id, topic_categories, collected_at, collected_date FROM dev_sean.default.channel_category WHERE canonical_id IS NOT NULL), latest AS (SELECT channel_id, topic_categories FROM (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.channel_id ORDER BY r.collected_at DESC, r.collected_date DESC) AS rn FROM raw_categories r INNER JOIN channels c ON r.channel_id = c.channel_id) WHERE rn = 1), exploded AS (SELECT l.channel_id, pos, CASE WHEN cat RLIKE '/wiki/' THEN regexp_replace(regexp_extract(cat, '/wiki/(.*)$', 1), '%20', '_') ELSE cat END AS topic_category FROM latest l LATERAL VIEW posexplode(array_distinct(filter(coalesce(l.topic_categories, CAST(array() AS ARRAY<STRING>)), x -> x IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(x)) > 0))) e AS pos, cat), first_tags AS (SELECT channel_id, topic_category AS first_topic_category FROM exploded WHERE pos = 0), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_with_nonempty_categories FROM first_tags) SELECT first_topic_category, COUNT(*) AS n_channels, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / MAX(n_with_nonempty_categories), 2) AS pct_of_nonempty_channels, CASE WHEN first_topic_category IN ('Music','Video_game_culture','Sport','Entertainment','Lifestyle_(sociology)','Society','Knowledge') THEN true ELSE false END AS first_is_broad_doc_topic FROM first_tags CROSS JOIN totals GROUP BY first_topic_category ORDER BY n_channels DESC, first_topic_category
